title: A Brief Study of the 28 Lunar Lodges Annotated Calendar: Focused on the Annotated Calendars of Dunhuang
central_claims: The study traces annotated-calendar development across Dunhuang, Turfan and Khara-khoto, and argues that tenth-century Dunhuang calendars combine twenty-eight lodges with the twelve houses of the Western zodiac.
